note: Stub. The palette is locked (PROJECT_SPEC §5); fonts, the real image style and the vocabulary are supplied by the user at Block 9. vocabulary is deliberately empty rather than guessed: Block 2 saw one brand name rendered three different ways across three identical correction calls, so these terms become load-bearing as transcription key terms once they exist. allowedTemplates holds stub ids until the real templates arrive in Block 6. Version 2 added imageVariation.

fonts.note: The user has fonts in use; their names are collected at Block 9 and recorded here. PROJECT_SPEC §5 forbids inventing them, and requireFonts() throws rather than substituting a default.

stylePrompt: a single clear idea, readable at a glance
lit against {{palette.background}}, with {{palette.light}} reserved for highlights
negativePrompt: nothing in frame that is not carrying the idea

imageVariation.note: The user's ruling (Block 3 session 3): the mode palette is dominant in every image, and composition, lighting and crop vary across the slots of one reel so the set reads as designed rather than batched. imageStyle.stylePrompt is the invariant half and applies unchanged to every slot — that is what keeps the palette dominant. These axes are the varying half. The specific terms are placeholders like the rest of this stub and are refined with the user at Block 9; the axis names are the part that is settled.

composition: subject off-centre with open space to one side
subject low in frame with headroom above
subject filling the frame edge to edge
lighting: hard directional light with defined shadow
soft diffuse light, shadows barely readable
rim light separating the subject from the ground
crop: wide, the whole subject with air around it
medium, the subject from the waist
macro, a single detail standing for the whole
